description_en: Queries the message sending volume metrics for a WhatsApp channel phone number
description_zh: 查询WhatsApp类型通道号码的发送量指标
name: GetChatappPhoneNumberMetric

parameters.help_en: The ISV verification code, which is used to verify whether the RAM user is authorized by the ISV
parameters.help_zh: ISV校验码，用于校验子账号是否由ISV授权
parameters.name: isv_code

parameters.help_en: The SpaceId or instance ID of the ISV sub-customer. This is the channel ID, which can be viewed on the <props="china">Channels Management (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">Channels Management (https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props> page
parameters.help_zh: ISV子客户的SpaceId/实例ID。即通道ID，在<props="china">通道管理 (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">通道管理 (https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props>界面查看
parameters.name: cust_space_id

parameters.help_en:
The metric granularity. Valid values:
DAILY: collects metrics on a daily basis.
HALF_HOUR: collects metrics every half hour
parameters.help_zh:
指标粒度。取值：
DAILY：按天统计指标。
HALF_HOUR：按每半小时统计指标
parameters.name: granularity

parameters.help_en: The query start time. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。时间戳，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en: The query end time. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间。时间戳，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end

parameters.help_en: The business phone number. This is the number used to send messages, which can be viewed on the <props="china">Channels Management (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">Channels Management (https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props> > Manage > WABA Management > Phone Number Management page
parameters.help_zh: 商业号码。即为您发送消息的号码，在<props="china">通道管理 (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">通道管理 (https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props>>管理>WABA管理>号码管理界面查看
parameters.name: phone_number

Code.description_en:
The request status code. Valid values:

OK: The request was successful.

For other error codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196974.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。取值：

OK：代表请求成功。

其他错误码，请参见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196974.html）

End.description_en: The end time of the metric collection period. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds
End.description_zh: 指标统计结束时间。时间戳，单位：毫秒

Start.description_en: The start time of the metric collection period. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds
Start.description_zh: 指标统计开始时间。时间戳，单位：毫秒
